def build_argv(std: Path, tool: Path, selectors: list[str], unwind: int, export: Path) -> list[str]:
    if not selectors or len(set(selectors)) != len(selectors):
        raise RunnerError("nonempty unique exact group selectors required")
    argv = [str((tool.resolve() / "scripts/kani")), "verify-std", "-Z", "unstable-options"]
    for feature in UNSTABLE:
        argv += ["-Z", feature]
    argv += ["--no-assert-contracts", "--jobs=1", "--harness-timeout", "600s"]
    for selector in selectors:
        argv += ["--harness", selector]
    argv += ["--exact", "--default-unwind", str(unwind), "-Z", "export-json",
             "--export-json", str(export.resolve()), "--output-format=regular", str((std.resolve() / "library")),
             "--cbmc-args", "--object-bits", "12"]
    return argv


def ci_env(std: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    fixed = "--cfg=kani_smallsort_sorting --cfg=kani_smallsort_controls --cfg=kani_smallsort_s2_assumed"
    inherited = env.get("RUSTFLAGS", "").strip()
    if inherited and inherited != fixed:
        raise RunnerError("refusing inherited RUSTFLAGS outside the frozen sorting+controls cfg")
    env["RUSTFLAGS"] = fixed
    env["NO_COLOR"] = "1"

- name: Read immutable export pins
      timeout-minutes: 1
      id: pins
      run: "python3 - <<'PYCODE'\nimport json, os\nr = json.load(open('control/ch8-s1-control/CI-REQUEST.json'))\nassert r['status'] == 'READY'\nwith open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as f:\n    f.write('std=' + r['std_sha'] + '\\n')\n    f.write('tool=' + r['tool_sha'] + '\\n')\nPYCODE\n"
    - name: Checkout production model export
      timeout-minutes: 5
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        repository: Tiramisu-Cake/verify-rust-std
        ref: ${{ steps.pins.outputs.std }}
        path: export
        fetch-depth: 5
        persist-credentials: false
        submodules: true
    - name: Checkout immutable upstream tool
      timeout-minutes: 2
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        repository: model-checking/kani
        ref: ${{ steps.pins.outputs.tool }}
        path: tool
        fetch-depth: 2
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Check all source identities
      timeout-minutes: 1
      run: python3 control/ch8-s1-control/runner.py check-source --std export --tool tool

- name: Run S2 batch3probes with bounded observations
      timeout-minutes: 126
      env:
        RECEIPT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/ch8-s1-receipts
        PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        S1_GROUP: s2-batch3probes-u34
      run: 'python3 control/ch8-s1-control/runner.py run --std export --tool tool --out "$RECEIPT_ROOT" --groups "$S1_GROUP"

        '
